text.card: A red giant 1,241 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.71 solar masses and 12.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,669 K at its surface.
